title: Pennsylvania selects RTA to modernize fleet management software
summary: State officials said the software upgrade will "help standardize processes across agencies” and allow the state to more efficiently deploy its thousands of fleet vehicles.

title: California agencies get access to Anthropic’s AI tools at half price
summary: California agencies will be able to use Anthropic's tools at half cost, to streamline administrative work, analyze large volumes of information, draft documents and improve constituent services.

title: The high cost of last-minute election overhauls
summary: For technical teams and election administrators, redrawing a congressional map is far more complicated than moving a line on a screen.

title: State, local governments can do more to safeguard LGBTQ+ data under Trump
summary: A new report claims states and local governments can do more to safeguard LGBTQ+ data in the face of hostile federal policies, including expanding data collection.

title: Advocacy groups call FCC’s E-Rate review an ‘attack’ on schools and libraries
summary: The FCC has initiated a broad review of the federal E-Rate program, opening the possibility for it to be limited or even terminated.

title: New group headed by former governors promises national AI workforce ‘people strategy’
summary: A new organization called RAISE US has secured state partnerships and commitments from private industry exceeding $500 million.

title: How states, cities can use federal funds to fix permitting delays with AI
summary: A federal grant program is helping states and cities to improve their permitting systems with AI. One former Colorado tech official said delays cost her family $100,000.

title: North Carolina appoints former GSA official to lead state’s procurement transformation
summary: Shannon Casucci, the former acting deputy associate chief information officer and IT director at the General Services Administration, will aid North Carolina in improving its procurement processes.

title: State and local governments ask Senate for $300M in cyber grant funding
summary: Providing $300 million for one year of grant appropriations would put the State and Local Cybersecurity Grant Program on par with past financing levels, according to a cohort of state and local government associations.

title: Texas launches ‘one stop shop’ website for info on New World screwworm outbreak
summary: On the new website, Texans can find information about the New World screwworm as well as fact sheets, videos and educational materials.
